articles.summary: Top Industry Honor Recognizes Brand’s Product Innovation and Growth Wolverine World Wide, Inc . (NYSE: WWW) today announced that its Saucony brand has been named 2026 Brand of the Year by Footwear News and will be recognized at the Footwear News Achievement Awards (FNAA) on Wednesday, December 2, in New York City. The honor recognizes Saucony’s continued focus on creating innovative products, building authentic consumer connections and bringing its distinctive brand story to life around the world. "Being named Brand of the Year is an incredible recognition of Saucony and the team behind it," said Chris Hufnagel, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wolverine Worldwide. "Saucony has a clear understanding of who it is, the consumers it serves and what makes the brand special. This recognition reflects the creativity, discipline and passion of the global Saucony team and is another powerful example of what great brand building looks like across Wolverine Worldwide." articles.summary: Wolverine World Wide, Inc. (NYSE: WWW) today reported financial results for the third quarter ended October 3, 2026. "We delivered a strong third quarter performance, led by our two largest brands and disciplined execution across the business," said Chris Hufnagel, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wolverine Worldwide. "This quarter, now our eighth consecutive quarter of growth, is further evidence that our transformation story is also a growth story – with continued earnings improvement and a healthier balance sheet providing us greater capacity to invest behind our brands and the opportunities we see ahead. While we continue to navigate a dynamic environment – based on our year-to-date results and our expectations for the final quarter of the year – we're raising our outlook for 2026." articles.summary: Wolverine World Wide, Inc. (NYSE: WWW) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share of common stock. The dividend is payable on February 1, 2027, to stockholders of record on January 4, 2027. The dividend is equal to the last quarterly dividend and reflects an indicated annual dividend of $0.40 per share. ABOUT WOLVERINE WORLDWIDE Wolverine World Wide, Inc. (NYSE: WWW) is a global footwear and apparel company driven by a vision to Make. Every Day. Better. Founded in 1883, the Company builds and grows iconic brands including Merrell® , Saucony® , Wolverine® , Sweaty Betty® , Chaco® , Hush Puppies® , Stride Rite® , HYTEST® , and Bates® , along with footwear licenses for Cat® and Harley-Davidson® .
